jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Loyalty Platform
jobs.content: <p>We are hiring a <strong>Principal Software Engineer</strong> for our loyalty and rewards platform.</p><h3>What you will do</h3><ul><li>Design event-driven services handling millions of daily transactions</li><li>Partner directly with product and customers</li><li>Ship agentic AI features into the rewards experience</li></ul><h3>Compensation</h3><p>The base salary range for this role is $220,000 - $265,000 per year.</p>

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Payments
jobs.content: <p>Lead a team of eight engineers building payment infrastructure.</p><ul><li>Own hiring and performance management</li><li>Drive platform reliability</li></ul>
